minimum_version.command: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 python -m pytest -q tests/test_svd.py tests/test_svd_replay.py tests/test_normal_svd_experimental.py --tb=short

lint: ruff check warpack tests benchmarks examples: passed
format: ruff format --check warpack tests benchmarks/experimental benchmarks/monitor_gpu.py: passed
production_scope: Device transpose-value refresh for SVD; Krylov restart and multiplicity guard unchanged. Early-chain exploration patch rejected and reverted.
experimental_scope: Matrix-free normal-product nonzero SVD outside installed package; normal equations square conditioning, strict physical counts and independent accuracy checks required. Not a supported public API.
upstream_scope: Large native ARPACK/Spectra/CuPy POD comparisons, not a full upstream conformance rerun.
performance: Uncontended large-POD comparisons and small application alternatives; no material augmented-SVD replay regression. Occupancy and per-trial accuracy records separate.
